subject: world_language
concept: Completing an extended capstone-style project demonstrating near-native command across reading, writing, speaking, and cultural fluency, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans an extended project combining sophisticated writing, oral presentation, and source synthesis
exercise.abstract: Student completes an extended near-native proficiency project combining sophisticated writing, fluent discussion, and multi-source synthesis in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: project demonstrates near-native command across all combined skill areas
misconception_flags: completes individual components at a high level but the overall project reads as disconnected rather than one unified demonstration of fluency

interest_binding: project topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
